mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, while tetrabenazine depletes monoamine stores; concurrent use risks severe hypertensive crisis, hyperthermia, and serotonin syndrome due to monoamine accumulation.
action: Contraindicated combination; avoid concurrent use or maintain minimum 14-day washout period after MAOI discontinuation before starting tetrabenazine.
